text:
Aisha: getting a steady trickle of tiny pod preempts in us-west1 starting ~02:00 PDT (09:00 UTC). not just one rack, seems spread across b/c.
Rui: saw it too. eviction spikes + kube-scheduler logs show many preemption decisions where nodes reported Ready but lacked taints/labels.
Noah: any recent node bootstrap or image change?
Marta: we pushed node-init v2 to 15% overnight. it reorders label/taint application to parallelize, maybe race.
deploy-bot: node-init-v2 canary: 3/15 hosts failed health checks. auto-rollback scheduled.
Aisha: some nodes also logged NVLINK attach timeouts and then nodefs eviction events. suspect driver flake + bootstrap race amplifies churn.
SRE_Oncall: immediate: cordoned all new joiners missing 'gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule', scaled down ASG joiners, rolling back node-init v2.
infra-tooling: added quick script to find nodes without expected taint: `kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.taints==null) | .metadata.name'`
Rui: followups: 1) gate node Ready on taint/label presence; 2) add driver health probe before marking Ready; 3) tighten ASG cooldown / ignore transient joins under X mins.
Noah: scheduler change idea: prefer nodes with label `bootstrap=complete` to reduce preemptive reschedules; will draft PR.
Marta: filing retro: bootstrap ordering, telemetry to alert on nodes joining without expected taints, update runbook.
Aisha: cost note: ASG added 28 instances, most stayed ~40m before we scaled down -> est extra ~$120. tag finance.
SRE_Oncall: eviction rate down ~60% after rollback & cordons. monitoring placed. will update incident doc with logs + kube events.
Aisha: thanks, closing for now — ping if we see recurrence :thumbsup:
